g.text: Same-source precision changes the measured trade-off

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4f6272

g.text: Qwen3.5-0.8B. Each precision used the same rendered token IDs. Two 12-case public splits with six task families.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4f6272

g.text: Four-bit G32 gained two public validation passes against G64. The exploratory paired interval was 0 to +4 cases.
